_about: MULTI-SYSTEM INHERITANCE MANIFEST (ROADMAP V / system-inheritance). For each MULTI-SYSTEM, INTRACTABLE (난치) monogenic disease already RESOLVED in this kit, the NECESSARY subset of VP body siblings whose organ-system STRUCTURE the single causal-gene lesion manifests in. The kit reads the ONE causal-gene promoter (suspension rule respected: every disease here is RESOLVED / readable); it then INHERITS, read-only, the γ-grounded structural context of each affected organ system from system_inheritance/sibling_registry.json, and surfaces -- structurally -- which compartments the lead corrective lever REACHES vs leaves as a GAP (the gap = the next, non-obvious treatment direction).
_firewall: STRUCTURE (which organ systems) + DIRECTION (which compartments the lead lever reaches) ONLY. Compartment reach is a qualitative biodistribution DIRECTION (does the modality class reach the compartment at all), cited; the DEGREE of correction in any compartment is always [O]. No dose, no efficacy, no magnitude.
_scope: INTRACTABLE multi-system monogenic disease, EXCLUDING the 'major' (dynamics-defined, common) disease each sibling owns (VP_FRAMEWORK_MAP section 6 -- enforced by the exclusion gate in pipeline/system_inheritance.py).
_provenance: Each disease's lead_lever_frozen + lead_modality_signature ECHO the disease's own frozen analysis.json lead_corrective_lever; the module fails closed if the frozen agent_class does not contain the declared signature token. inherited_systems map to real organ-master γ in the registry (or to a declared compartment anchor for the neural compartment).

fabry_disease.intractable_rationale: X-linked lysosomal storage; the approved enzyme replacement does NOT cross the blood-brain barrier, so the small-fibre neuropathy / CNS compartment is not addressed -- a multi-compartment unmet need this kit already records.

inherited_systems.reason: Gb3/GL-3 accumulates in vascular endothelium -> angiokeratoma, vasculopathy
podocyte Gb3 accumulation -> proteinuric Fabry nephropathy
cardiomyocyte Gb3 -> LV hypertrophy / conduction disease (incl. the IVS4+919 cardiac variant)
dorsal-root-ganglion / small-fibre involvement -> acroparaesthesia, the BBB-excluded compartment

falsifier.claim: the IV enzyme reaches the systemic (vascular/renal/cardiac) compartments but not the CNS/PNS compartment
falsifier.falsifier: demonstrate recombinant alpha-galactosidase A correcting neuronal/DRG Gb3 after IV dosing without a BBB-crossing modification -> the reach-gap direction is wrong
falsifier.measurable_by: neuronal Gb3 / lyso-Gb3 after IV enzyme vs a BBB-penetrant route in a Fabry model

pompe_disease.disease: Pompe disease (glycogen storage disease type II)
pompe_disease.intractable_rationale: lysosomal glycogen storage; enzyme replacement rescues cardiac and skeletal muscle unevenly and the CNS compartment is poorly reached, leaving residual motor and respiratory burden.

inherited_systems.reason: lysosomal glycogen in skeletal myofibres -> proximal myopathy
infantile-onset hypertrophic cardiomyopathy from cardiomyocyte glycogen
diaphragm/respiratory-muscle glycogen -> respiratory failure (the leading cause of death)

falsifier.claim: IV enzyme reaches cardiac + skeletal-muscle compartments; CNS is poorly reached
falsifier.falsifier: show IV alglucosidase clears motor-neuron/CNS glycogen as effectively as cardiac glycogen -> the uneven-reach direction is wrong
falsifier.measurable_by: glycogen clearance by compartment (cardiac vs skeletal vs CNS) after IV enzyme in a Pompe model

cystic_fibrosis.intractable_rationale: multi-epithelial channelopathy; CFTR modulators reach every CFTR-expressing epithelium systemically but are GENOTYPE-LIMITED (only modulator-responsive alleles), leaving non-responsive genotypes without a switch-level option.

inherited_systems.reason: airway-surface-liquid dehydration -> mucus plugging, bronchiectasis (the dominant burden)
ductal CFTR loss -> exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, CF-related diabetes
intestinal CFTR loss -> meconium ileus / DIOS
biliary CFTR loss -> CF liver disease / focal biliary cirrhosis
congenital bilateral absence of the vas deferens (CBAVD) -> male infertility

falsifier.claim: the oral modulator reaches all CFTR epithelia but only for modulator-responsive genotypes
falsifier.falsifier: show a CFTR potentiator restoring chloride conductance in a class-I (no-protein) genotype -> the genotype-limited-reach direction is wrong
falsifier.measurable_by: CFTR-mediated chloride current vs CFTR genotype class in patient-derived epithelia

cystinosis.intractable_rationale: lysosomal cystine-transporter defect; systemic aminothiol depletes cystine in perfused tissues but the AVASCULAR cornea is poorly reached by the systemic route -> corneal cystine crystals require a SEPARATE topical direction.

inherited_systems.reason: proximal-tubule cystine -> renal Fanconi syndrome then ESRD (the life-limiting compartment)
corneal cystine crystals (photophobia) -- the avascular eye compartment poorly reached by systemic cysteamine, requiring topical drops

falsifier.claim: systemic cysteamine reaches the renal compartment but not the avascular cornea (topical needed)
falsifier.falsifier: show oral cysteamine clearing corneal crystals as well as topical drops -> the avascular-cornea reach-gap is wrong
falsifier.measurable_by: corneal crystal density under systemic-only vs systemic+topical cysteamine

tuberous_sclerosis_complex.intractable_rationale: a dominant multisystem hamartoma syndrome; the mTOR inhibitor restrains lesions across organs (including CNS SEGA) but is cytostatic -- lesions regrow on withdrawal, so the switch-level (TSC restore) direction stays open.

inherited_systems.reason: subependymal giant-cell astrocytoma (SEGA), cortical tubers -> epilepsy / TAND
renal angiomyolipoma (the leading cause of TSC mortality in adults)
facial angiofibroma, hypomelanotic macules, shagreen patch
cardiac rhabdomyoma (often regresses; arrhythmia risk in infancy)
lymphangioleiomyomatosis (LAM) -> cystic lung disease in females

falsifier.claim: the systemic rapalogue reaches all hamartoma compartments including CNS (everolimus is approved for SEGA)
falsifier.falsifier: show an mTOR inhibitor failing to reach the CNS SEGA compartment at a tissue-suppressing exposure -> the systemic-incl-CNS reach is wrong
falsifier.measurable_by: lesion-volume response by compartment (SEGA vs AML vs skin) on a rapalogue

bardet_biedl_syndrome.intractable_rationale: a primary ciliopathy across four organ systems; the approved MC4R agonist bypasses the broken cilium ONLY at the hypothalamic satiety node -- the retina, kidney and limb compartments have NO approved therapy, the starkest multi-compartment reach gap in the kit.

inherited_systems.reason: ciliary leptin-melanocortin signalling fails -> hyperphagia / obesity (the ONLY compartment the lead lever reaches)
rod-cone dystrophy -> progressive blindness (no approved therapy)
renal cystic / dysplastic disease -> CKD (no approved therapy)
post-axial polydactyly (developmental ciliary patterning)

falsifier.claim: the MC4R agonist reaches ONLY the satiety compartment; retina/kidney/limb are not addressed
falsifier.falsifier: show setmelanotide slowing the retinal dystrophy or renal decline -> the satiety-only reach is wrong
falsifier.measurable_by: ERG / eGFR trajectory on setmelanotide vs the obesity endpoint it is approved for

wilson_disease.intractable_rationale: a copper-transport defect with hepatic, neurological and ocular deposition; the CONTRAST case where the systemic chelator DOES reach every compartment (including CNS copper) -- showing the reach read is not a blanket pessimism but a per-modality structural fact.

inherited_systems.reason: hepatic copper accumulation -> hepatitis / cirrhosis / acute liver failure
basal-ganglia copper -> dystonia, tremor, dysarthria (neurologic Wilson)
Kayser-Fleischer corneal copper rings (the diagnostic ocular sign)

falsifier.claim: the systemic chelator reaches all copper-deposition compartments including the CNS
falsifier.falsifier: show a copper chelator failing to mobilise CNS copper while clearing hepatic copper -> the all-compartment systemic reach is wrong
falsifier.measurable_by: brain vs liver copper / free-copper response to chelation

hereditary_haemochromatosis_type_1.intractable_rationale: systemic iron overload across liver, pancreas, heart, joints and gonad; phlebotomy removes iron from the whole parenchymal pool via plasma equilibration -- a second all-compartment-reach contrast, but it does NOT restore the hepcidin brake (the switch-level direction stays open).

inherited_systems.reason: hepatocyte iron -> fibrosis / cirrhosis / HCC risk
islet iron -> 'bronze diabetes'
myocardial iron -> cardiomyopathy / arrhythmia
iron arthropathy (2nd/3rd MCP joints the classic site)
pituitary/gonadal iron -> hypogonadotropic hypogonadism

falsifier.claim: phlebotomy lowers iron across all parenchymal compartments via plasma equilibration
falsifier.falsifier: show a parenchymal iron pool that phlebotomy cannot mobilise while plasma ferritin normalises -> the all-compartment reach is wrong
falsifier.measurable_by: tissue iron (hepatic / cardiac MRI T2*) vs serum ferritin across a phlebotomy course
